placements.why: Establishes an organizational strata home for policies, mandates, and controls over institutional knowledge retention and historical record expungement.
placements.title: Institutional Knowledge Lifecycle and Retention Directives
placements.frame: How does the organization govern the retention, deprecation, and expungement of institutional knowledge and technical history?

placements.title: Mandating Total Expungement of Specific Decisions and Architectural Migrations
placements.frame: Under what authority and scope are past technical decisions and migration histories actively removed from organizational knowledge?
placements.why: Both expressions issue direct, authoritative operational mandates ordering the total erasure of specific past decisions and technical migration records.
